title: Post-hoc D3 native-FR rank-boundary sensitivity: K150/200/300
weights: Reuse original matched-input frozen w0 and wM. No weight re-estimation on F, no mixing coefficient, no post-result subgroup selection.
fr_native: Authors sparse PCA/SPAMS and Lasso algorithm, TP10K/log1p, control centering, native scaling. Full precision serialization; no external atlas.
fr_gene_axis: All original raw genes, input-only native filtering. Query outputs aligned by exact gene identifier. No reference-driven gene selection.

development.objective: highest native FR P@25 over original responsive query panel, mean of signed directions
development.ties: Within 1e-12 choose official default if tied, else lowest listed index
development.failed_runs: Retain errors, no zero imputation. Numerical or resource failure is not a method loss. All grid runs required for strongest-in-grid claim.

transfer.configuration: single D3 native-FR winner, frozen before any D4 FR scores
transfer.reference: original task reference; no target or query changes
transfer.analysis_scope: opened data fixed-configuration transfer, not new blinded donor confirmation

independent_guide.reference_quality: retain prior report; this analysis does not overturn original metric-increment stop
independent_guide.analysis_scope: opened independent-guide task, not independent laboratory

sampling_and_scores.own_target: exclude by stable gene identity before top K
sampling_and_scores.queries: original frozen panels and 30 original blocks
sampling_and_scores.controls: same cells available to every method

randomness.fit_seed: base+input_rep, equal across configurations; record native solver randomness limitations

uncertainty.pooled: mean five inputs within query; paired original query-block bootstrap; conditional on observed inputs/reference. Report all input repetitions separately. Reference uncertainty only if actual reference-cell resampling executed.
uncertainty.independent: joint target-by-lane reference and paired query-block resampling using existing archived cell-level reference; same reference and NTC draws across arms
uncertainty.multiple_contrasts: 95% paired intervals descriptive; 99% Bonferroni intervals for five prespecified contrasts if simultaneous claims are made

development_gates.interpretation: resource allocation only, not confirmatory success
development_gates.direct: PR-F positive in both D4 states; equal-state mean >=0.01; paired conditional 95% lower bound >0; at least 4/5 equal-state input-rep differences positive
development_gates.complementarity: wM*F-F positive in both states, equal-state mean >=0.005 with paired conditional 95% lower bound >0; wM*F-w0*F positive in both states with equal-state paired conditional 95% lower bound >0
development_gates.stop: Pause expansion if neither route passes; preserve all runs. No claim of universal plug-in layer from one external method.

engineering_gates.smoke: <=10 minutes full-gene synthetic and 32-target real-data compute check, no D4 scoring
engineering_gates.small: <=1 hour engineering pilot then extrapolate full runtime and memory
engineering_gates.failed_or_nonconverged: record as failed/not evaluable, never score as all-zero or count as a win
engineering_gates.resource_limit: do not alter native inference silently; document before-result amendments if technically necessary

additional_external.ASH: official ashr posterior mean, normal and halfuniform prior configurations selected only on D3
additional_external.TRADE_posterior: official halfuniform fit core full posterior mean adaptation, not scalar; explicit native mixEM numerical sensitivity below
additional_external.optimizer_rule: mixsqp primary. Official mixEM retry only on explicit numerical failure/nonconvergence with fixed 10000 iterations; log both. Keep solver-specific results and no winner selection by D4 performance. A failed full arm remains unavailable without valid complete outputs.
additional_external.GPerturb: only after FR milestone; prepare explicit convergence/resource budget before training; lack of GPU or incomplete training is not a loss

reference_sensitivity: Keep original log-effect reference primary. A separately specified Pearson-reference implementation is secondary only; fit parameters on designated controls and verify rankings change. No sensitive reference is substituted for original.

amendment_03.reason: Historical PertRank development included a 7x3 control-geometry scan on D3; six FR settings did not constitute matching search breadth. Strengthen native FR before any new performance observation.
amendment_03.unchanged: Same native algorithm, input cells, spca alpha .1, native 50 iterations, fit seeds, D3-only P25 selection, default-first tie rule, six arms, data access, downstream endpoints and gates.
amendment_03.budget: 21 sequential D3 fits, target <=1 hour after input recovery; pause and log resource failure if exceeded, never assign a failed fit zero performance.
amendment_03.claim_limit: Matching 21 configurations does not equate historical compute or tuning: prior PR objective was energy rank correlation and included additional diagnostics. Report these differences explicitly.
amendment_03.applicability: Use this full effective protocol via --protocol/--spec; preserve original EXECUTION_SPEC unchanged. Amendments 01 and 02 remain effective.

retrospective_context: Original D3 21-grid and opened D4 primary results were already available. New ranks are sensitivity only, not a replacement winner search.
ranking_scope: Same frozen D3 Rest rep0 responsive panels, raw input, original weights, references and exact-tie signed P25/P10 scoring.

full_rank_definition.dictionary_parameter: K learned SPAMS atoms, not a guarantee of algebraic dictionary rank

resource_plan.timeout_policy: Preserve incomplete output as a resource failure; never zero score; no automatic alternate algorithm or shortened iteration retry.
resource_plan.full_dimension_not_attempted: Existing wrapper requires K<retained genes; native dense conversion alone exceeds8GiB for K15616. No rank1200 or identity surrogate is called native full rank.

convergence: Official SPAMS trainDL 50 fixed iterations; no claimed dictionary convergence. Same native sklearn dualgap + independent objectivegap audit v2 required; coefficient delta diagnostic only.
